components.explanation: REWIND tint: rewind_tint.gdshader (canvas_item; colour line suggested by Claude, typed by Tharun) on one ShaderMaterial per fighter, fed by rewind_tint_driver.gd (Claude, agent session) from fighter.state with move_toward x delta; attached in main.gd; F9 debug captures in debug_capture.gd.

painted_tin.gdshader (spatial; skeleton suggested by Claude, typed and filled by Tharun) with three Poly Haven Metal Plate samplers (colour, normal, roughness as wear mask); two materials toybox_fresh / toybox_worn; Use External wiring in toybox.glb.import and the second toy box in prop_room.tscn; audit in MATERIALS.md.
Hint experiment (hint_experiment.gdshader, the 3x1 PNG, two materials and scene) and the editor-generated standard_generated.gdshader annotated by Tharun.
test_rewind_tint.gd (agent; R1-R6 at 30/60/144 through real input), test_materials.gd (Claude audit), and the normal-map calibration/check scripts.
Claude-made windowed capture tools and resource builders (tools/a5_*.gd, make_*.gd, write_hint_png.gd); evidence only, not loaded by the game.
project.godot: reordered rendering lines only (the A5 import pass); renderer and settings unchanged.

code_result_pairs.observation: In-engine captures (scripted input) at rewind_amount 0.0 / 0.5 / 1.0 / 2.0: the colour line output at Bolt's chest and helmet equals Tharun's hand predictions (12 of 12 channels at 0 and 0.5; four channels -1 at 1.0); at 2.0 both pixels are the pure tint (90, 160, 255).

source_view_code_result_pairs.observation: Movie Maker capture (scripted input, isolated copy of 2e6946d): Bolt tints blue within 5 frames of the press, Rivet hits him (REWIND -> HURT) and the tint fades out from 1.0; readout from the per-frame log.

resource_name = "toybox_fresh"
render_priority = 0
shader = ExtResource("1_78inm")
shader_parameter/metal_albedo = ExtResource("2_ny66c")

shader_parameter/metal_rough = ExtResource("4_ihh2e")
shader_parameter/paint_roughness = 0.3
shader_parameter/wear_amount = 0.05

resource_name = "toybox_worn"
render_priority = 0
shader = ExtResource("1_1xxbb")
shader_parameter/metal_albedo = ExtResource("2_lhxcb")
shader_parameter/metal_normal = ExtResource("3_04qot")
shader_parameter/metal_rough = ExtResource("4_nutc4")
shader_parameter/paint_roughness = 0.7
shader_parameter/wear_amount = 0.55

source_view_code_result_pairs.observation: Edit checks: the shader edit changed both boxes (88 px, 1622 px); the material edit changed only the worn box (6698 px); castle 0 px both times.
Hint experiment capture: quad S shows 64/128/192, quad D 137/188/225, exactly as Tharun predicted by hand.

sources.text: uniform sampler2D texture_albedo : source_color, filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable; // Albedo sampler with sRGB color conversion and mipmapping
uniform sampler2D texture_normal : hint_roughness_normal, filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable; // Normal map sampler with normal map decoding hints
uniform sampler2D metal_albedo : source_color, filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable;
uniform sampler2D metal_normal : hint_normal, filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_enable;
